headline: Deep learning and docking pipelines yield candidate inhibitors across diverse targets
label: Ai Driven Molecular Binder Design
summary: Recent studies combine deep learning, docking, and MD to prioritize inhibitors and binders across bacterial, fungal, viral, and human targets.
synthesis: The common thread is a computational pipeline in which learned models, whether de novo sequence design or deep-learning potency predictors, feed docking and molecular dynamics to prioritize candidates. The AbcA study generates 7200 de novo binders for the Aspergillus fumigatus efflux pump ATP site using ProteinMPNN, docking, and MD. The HDAC8 study pairs a deep-learning potency model trained on 4583 ChEMBL compounds (test R2 0.617) with SELFIES generation and 200 ns MD of a lead. The ABCG2 study combines a deep-learning model with screening of about 1.58 million compounds and reports inhibitors that reverse adriamycin resistance in breast cancer. Docking and MD also address NDM-1 with cyclic boronates, where bicyclic boronates show greater binding, as well as TRPV1, MMP-12 (test R2 0.924, without experimental validation), and HIV reverse transcriptase.
